title: Apple Inc. Form 10-K Audited Consolidated Financial Statements

chunks.text:
Apple Inc. Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions, except per share amounts):
- Fiscal Year Ended Sept 25, 2021: Total Net Sales: $365,817; Cost of Sales: $212,981; Gross Margin: $152,836; Operating Expenses: $43,887; Operating Income: $108,949; Net Income: $94,680.
- Fiscal Year Ended Sept 24, 2022: Total Net Sales: $394,328; Cost of Sales: $223,546; Gross Margin: $170,782; Operating Expenses: $51,345; Operating Income: $119,437; Net Income: $99,803.
- Fiscal Year Ended Sept 30, 2023: Total Net Sales: $383,285; Cost of Sales: $214,137; Gross Margin: $169,148; Operating Expenses: $54,847; Operating Income: $114,301; Net Income: $96,995.
- Fiscal Year Ended Sept 28, 2024: Total Net Sales: $391,035; Cost of Sales: $210,352; Gross Margin: $180,683; Operating Expenses: $57,467; Operating Income: $123,216; Net Income: $93,736.

Apple Inc. Segment Revenue Summary (in millions):
- iPhone Revenue: FY2022: $205,489; FY2023: $200,583; FY2024: $201,183.
- Services Revenue (App Store, Cloud, Apple Pay, Apple Music): FY2022: $78,129; FY2023: $85,200; FY2024: $96,169.
- Mac Revenue: FY2022: $40,177; FY2023: $29,357; FY2024: $29,984.
- iPad Revenue: FY2022: $29,292; FY2023: $28,300; FY2024: $26,694.
- Wearables, Home and Accessories: FY2022: $41,241; FY2023: $39,845; FY2024: $37,005.

relations.description: Services revenue grew from $78,129M in FY22 to $96,169M in FY24

title: Microsoft Corp Form 10-K Audited Financial Statements

- FY2023 (Ended June 30, 2023): Total Revenue: $211,915; Operating Income: $88,523; Net Income: $72,361; Intelligent Cloud Revenue: $87,907.
- FY2024 (Ended June 30, 2024): Total Revenue: $245,122; Operating Income: $109,433; Net Income: $88,136; Intelligent Cloud Revenue: $105,362.
